mcqs.question: Under the RBI’s special FCNR(B) deposit swap facility, what inflow was expected, potentially requiring banks to raise interest rates by 100 basis points?
mcqs.explanation: The expected inflow under the facility was $50–70 billion, and banks might need to raise rates by 100 basis points because US dollar rates were above 4%. The $7.1 billion, $16.16 billion and $14.41 billion figures relate to other NRI deposit data, not the expected inflow under this measure.
